verdict.rationale: Wise's own documentation directly claims global payments are sent in under 20 seconds, with most transfers arriving in that time, which is well within the story's one-minute bar. A delivery-estimate API also lets users see when funds are expected to arrive. The claim is qualified as 'most', with no breakdown of which corridors or currencies qualify. missing for 10: per-corridor or per-currency speed coverage, documentation of when transfers are slower, independent or hands-on corroboration of arrival times.
